sentences.en: It seems like the simplest choice in the world.

sentences.en: and indulgence.

sentences.en: At Stanford University, psychiatrist Anna Lemke has heard the same messages.

sentences.en: But as a scientist, she's also studied the way our brains balance pain and pleasure.
sentences.zh: 但作为一名科学家，她也研究过我们的大脑是如何平衡痛苦与快乐的。

sentences.en: The two sit on opposite ends of a neural seesaw,
sentences.zh: 这两者位于神经跷跷板的两端，

sentences.en: and the brain constantly attempts to bring them into equilibrium, or what is known as homeostasis.
sentences.zh: 大脑会不断尝试让它们达到平衡，也就是所谓的“稳态”。

sentences.en: When we press down hard and often on the pleasure side of the seesaw,
sentences.zh: 当我们用力且频繁地压下跷跷板的快乐一端时，

sentences.en: triggering bursts of the neurotransmitter dopamine,
sentences.zh: 会触发神经递质多巴胺的爆发，

sentences.en: Anna says the brain automatically compensates by pressing down on the other side,
sentences.zh: 安娜说，大脑会自动通过压下另一端来进行补偿，

sentences.en: producing a dopamine deficit.
sentences.zh: 从而导致多巴胺亏空。

sentences.en: Over time, as people press down too much or too often on the pleasure side of the equation,
sentences.zh: 久而久之，当人们在快乐这一端压得太重或太频繁时，

sentences.en: the brain compensates so forcefully that we start to walk around with a chronic dopamine deficit.
sentences.zh: 大脑的补偿反应会非常强烈，以至于我们开始长期处于多巴胺亏空的状态。

sentences.en: This can manifest as anxiety, irritability, and depression.
sentences.zh: 这可能表现为焦虑、易怒和抑郁。

sentences.en: There is complex neurochemistry behind the process of homeostasis,
sentences.zh: 稳态过程背后有着复杂的神经化学机制，

sentences.en: but Ana has come up with a simple way to visualize this.
sentences.zh: 但安娜想出了一种简单的方法来直观地理解这一点。

sentences.en: When you press down on one side of the seesaw,
sentences.zh: 当你压下跷跷板的一端时，
